        ### Question
        What proteins are synthesized in the ribosomes attached to the endoplasmic reticulum ?:

opd. The secretion proteins.

CHAIN: Signal recognition particle (SRP) recognizes the signal sequence -> guides the ribosome to the endoplasmic reticulum -> protein synthesis occurs -> secretion proteins are synthesized -> 85%
